Meet the VPM Award Winning News Team The VPM News team delivers award-winning coverage of local issues that matter most to our communities. VPM is Virginia’s home for public media and that means we want to hear from you. Meet the News Team VPM News is a go-to source for trusted, factual local news in Virginia. Headquartered in Richmond with a small team in Charlottesville, VPM News delivers award-winning coverage of local issues that matter most to its communities: Virginia’s General Assembly; statewide politics and elections; educational, economic, environmental and legal issues; healthcare; local events; infrastructure; and the news of the day.To report a news tip or suggestion or to contact the VPM News team, email our newsroom at tips@vpm.org.
